subject.title: fix(release): bind npm publishing to approved package bytes

question: After all supported callers pass the exact preflight attempt, do release owners approve removing run-ID-only npm promotion and recovery?
rationale: The permanent contract intentionally tightens a protected release security and operator boundary; automation can fix the missed caller but cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Fix callers and approve strict binding
options.body: Update Tideclaw and any remaining callers to pass the exact attempt, then adopt the stricter immutable contract.

options.title: Pause strict rollout
options.body: Hold the PR if any supported release or recovery path cannot yet provide attempt-qualified evidence.

recommendation.title: Fix callers and approve strict binding
recommendation.body: Update Tideclaw and any remaining callers to pass the exact attempt, then adopt the stricter immutable contract.
